Plugins.Description:
Collects power and temperature metrics using the NVIDIA Management Library (NVML)
 API
Plugins.ExtendedDescriptionForGui:
Options:
  -i | --interval  Sampling interval in milliseconds (default: 100)
  -g | --gpu-devices  GPUs to be sampled. Available options are: all, cuda-visible, or a comma-separated
                      list of GPU IDs (e.g., 0,1,3) (default: cuda-visible)

The power usage is collected in Watts using the `nvmlDeviceGetFieldValues` API
function.
The GPU temperature is collected in degrees Celsius with the
`nvmlDeviceGetTemperature` API function.

Plugins.Description: Collects AWS EFA Infiniband and Ethernet metrics
Collect SCADA metrics (e.g. clients, buffers, requests) from a SCADA server.
Collect traffic quantity, throughput and operation counters of mounted remote volumes.

Plugins.ExtendedDescriptionForGui:
Options:
  -i | --interval  Sampling interval in microseconds (default: 100000)
  -d | --device    Device name as regular expression
                   (default: all physical devices)
  -m | --metric    Metric name as regular expression (default: .*_bytes)

To specify multiple devices and metrics the respective options can be used
multiple times and as regular expression.
When using `-d all` or `--device=all` all adapters will be considered (not only
physical ones).
When using `-m all` or `--metric=all` all metrics will be considered (not only
metrics in bytes).
